alloy: all u: Unit | miscited[u] => u in Misnesting
all a: Axiom | (some v: Unit | cites[a, v] and v not in Axiom) => a in Misnesting
all f: Fact | (some u: Unit | cites[f, u]) => f in Misnesting
all s: Spec | (some v: Unit | cites[s, v] and v not in Axiom and v not in Spec and v not in Fact) => s in Misnesting
all b: Bug, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) => b in OutdatedTracking
all b: Bug | (some Runner and not tested[b]) => b in Untesting
all c: Conflict | hidden[c] => c in Finding
all t: Tag | (no u: Unit | t->u in Name.tag) => t in Rotting
all t: Test | adrift[t] => t in Finding
all t: Test | (t in Declared and (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel)) => t in Uncitation
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel => d2->d1 in Context.rel
doubt: Statement may involve transitivity which would require a separate constraint about context composition

alloy: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) => u->f in Blocks.rel
all f: Fence | f not in Languaged => (no u: Unit | u->f in Blocks.rel)
no Runner => (no u: Unit | u in Untesting)
no Tracker => (no u: Unit | u in Untracking)

all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) => r in Exits2
all f: Frontmatter | f in Foreign => f in Refused
all f: Frontmatter | f in Unclosed => f in Refused
all f: Frontmatter | f in Unterminated => f in Refused
(some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) => all r: Run | r in Exits2
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) => (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) => c in Unknown
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel => ((some u: Unit | d1->u in Hold.units and u in Finding) iff (some u: Unit | d2->u in Hold.units and u in Finding))
doubt: Interpretation assumes finding is reported for units held by document; exact meaning of 'reports a finding for a document' is ambiguous

alloy: (some d: Document, a: Axiom, s: Spec, idx: Index, t: Test, tag: Tag | d->a in Hold.units and a->s in Sit.rel and d->idx in Hold.indexes and idx->d in Match.rel and t in Declared and t->tag in Carry.rel and tag->s in Name.tag) and (all u: Unit | u not in Finding)
some b: Bug, e: ExpectedFailure, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and checks[e, b] and b not in Finding and e not in Finding)
all u: Unit | (u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable) => u in Current
all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) => u in Handwritten
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) => u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Wordless => u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Current => u not in Reported
all r: Run | (r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel and (some u: Unit | u in Reported)) => r not in Exits0
all r: Run, u: Unit | (r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) => (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) => w in Flagged
all u: Unit, d1: Document | (d1->u in Hold.units and d1 not in Checked and (some d2: Document | d2 in Checked and d1->d2 in Context.rel)) => u not in Rewritten
all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d2->d1 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w in Voice.rel and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Introduce.rel) => w not in Undeclared
all s: Scenario | s in Possible => s not in Raised
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Raised and u->s in Frees.rel) => u->s in Blame.rel
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (u->s in Blame.rel) => (u->s in Frees.rel)
all u: Unit | (u in Held and u in Contradicting) => u in Named
all u: Unit, w: Word | (loneOn[u, w] and u not in Term) => u->w in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Expose.rel) => u in Unchallenged
all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Expose.rel) => (u in Logical and u not in Term and w in Signature and loneOn[u, w])
all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (u1 != u2 and u2->w in Utter.rel) => (u1->w not in Expose.rel)
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst) => s in OneLine
all d: Definition | (d in GuardedByKind and byKind[d]) => d in PhrasePerKind
all q: Quantifier | q in VariableTwice => q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach => q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | (q in NoWithAnother and q in VariableWithCondition) => q in InFull
all s: Series | s in RelativeBeforeLast => s in AsBullets
all s: Series | s in NotClause => s in AsBullets
all s: Series | s in AndInOr => s in KeepsAndApart
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst and s in TimeSecond) => s in KeepsThen
some d: Definition | (d in OrInsideKind and (some alt: Definition | alt not in GuardedByKind))
doubt: Interpretation: 'it must be possible' means satisfiable scenario; exact scope of 'alternative' is unclear

alloy: some s: Series | (s in MoreThanTwo and s in Few and s in CommaItem)
doubt: Interpretation assumes 'three or fewer' = Few and 'more than two' = MoreThanTwo, which may overlap

alloy: some s: Series | (s in Few and s in TooLong)

always ((all o: Owner, c: Failing | (c in Ran and c.on = o and o in Disposed) => always (o not in Threw)) and (all o: Owner, c: Failing | (c in Ran and c.on = o and o in Disposed) => eventually (c->c.handler in reached)))
some o: Owner, c: Failing | eventually (o in Disposed and c.on = o and eventually (c in Ran and eventually (c->o.handler in reached)))
